one_line: Code hosting and collaboration platform with a very broad REST and GraphQL API for repos, issues, PRs and Actions.
auth_notes: OAuth2 apps, classic/fine-grained personal access tokens, GitHub App installation tokens (JWT) and device flow; scopes/permissions per token type
self_serve_notes: Free accounts; PATs and OAuth apps are self-serve in user settings; fine-grained tokens scoped to repos

api_surface.breadth_estimate: 198+ REST endpoint categories (repos, issues, pulls, Actions, Packages, Codespaces, orgs, etc.) plus GraphQL API; fully described in OpenAPI
api_surface.webhook_note: Repository and org webhooks for push, PR, issue, release events; also Actions workflow events

existing_mcp.note: Official GitHub MCP server exists (knowledge); fetched text confirms REST API, versioning and OpenAPI description

evidence.note: fetched text confirms REST API docs, authentication article, versioning and OpenAPI

agent_notes: Trivially buildable; PAT or OAuth2 both work; official MCP server available.
